architecture.rule: Apple Watch talks only to the versioned Watch API facade; it must not call Matrix, AUX, orchestrator, or game-bridge internals directly.

game.activation_gate: Phase 2 promoted and game provider contract accepted

uv.activation_gate: Phase 2 UV provider promoted and physically accepted

production_promotion_gates: Watch receives/stores its own paired device session token
canonical cart status and at least one non-destructive command pass from Watch
stale-revision behavior is verified on Watch
score staging interaction is physically accepted
no direct legacy Matrix/AUX Watch control path remains active
